evals.prompt: Can you review this UserService.java? It's a service class we use for user management in our Spring Boot app. We've been seeing some intermittent issues in production and I want a fresh pair of eyes on it.
evals.expected_output: Should identify: SQL injection vulnerabilities, resource leaks (no try-with-resources), thread-unsafe SimpleDateFormat, singleton anti-pattern without thread safety, empty catch blocks, hardcoded credentials, string comparison with ==, null returns instead of Optional, string concat in loop, instanceof chain instead of polymorphism

assertions.name: identifies_sql_injection
assertions.description: Flags SQL string concatenation as a security vulnerability and suggests PreparedStatement

assertions.name: identifies_resource_leak
assertions.description: Notes missing try-with-resources for Connection/Statement/ResultSet

assertions.name: identifies_thread_unsafe_dateformat
assertions.description: Catches shared static SimpleDateFormat as not thread-safe

assertions.name: identifies_empty_catch
assertions.description: Calls out the silent catch block that swallows exceptions

assertions.name: identifies_hardcoded_credentials
assertions.description: Flags hardcoded database credentials in source code

assertions.name: identifies_string_comparison_with_eq
assertions.description: Catches == used for string comparison instead of .equals()

assertions.name: identifies_instanceof_chain
assertions.description: Suggests polymorphism over instanceof chain in isAdmin()

assertions.name: structured_output
assertions.description: Review follows a clear structure with severity-based categorization

evals.prompt: Hey, I wrote this order processing class. Can you take a look and tell me if there are any issues? We're planning to deploy it next week.
evals.expected_output: Should identify: ArrayList used in concurrent context (not thread-safe), CachedThreadPool used for potentially blocking DB I/O, resource leak in saveOrder, double rounding issue (integer division), divide-by-zero in calculateAverageOrderValue, unnecessary parallel stream for simple filter, string status instead of enum, processing flag race condition

assertions.name: identifies_thread_safety_arraylist
assertions.description: Flags ArrayList used with concurrent ExecutorService submissions

assertions.name: identifies_resource_leak_saveorder
assertions.description: Notes Connection/PreparedStatement not closed in saveOrder

assertions.name: identifies_divide_by_zero
assertions.description: Catches potential division by zero in calculateAverageOrderValue when list is empty

assertions.name: identifies_rounding_bug
assertions.description: Notes integer division issue in Math.round(total * 100) / 100

assertions.name: identifies_cachedthreadpool_io
assertions.description: Warns about CachedThreadPool with blocking database I/O

assertions.name: identifies_string_status
assertions.description: Suggests enum over string literals for order status

assertions.name: structured_output
assertions.description: Review follows a clear structure with severity-based categorization

evals.prompt: Review this generic cache implementation. I want to make sure it's production-ready before we start using it across our microservices.
evals.expected_output: Should identify: Not thread-safe despite likely multi-threaded usage, ConcurrentModificationException in evictExpired, singleton with raw types and unchecked cast, getAll() exposes internal mutable state, reflection-based loadFromObject is dangerous and fragile, StringBuilder should be used in generateReport, race condition in getOrDefault

assertions.name: identifies_not_thread_safe
assertions.description: Flags HashMap-based cache as not thread-safe for multi-threaded microservice use

assertions.name: identifies_concurrent_modification
assertions.description: Catches ConcurrentModificationException risk in evictExpired iterating and removing

assertions.name: identifies_mutable_state_exposure
assertions.description: Flags getAll() returning internal mutable map directly

assertions.name: identifies_reflection_abuse
assertions.description: Warns about loadFromObject using reflection - fragile, unsafe, and unnecessary

assertions.name: identifies_string_concat_loop
assertions.description: Notes StringBuilder should be used in generateReport instead of string concatenation

assertions.name: identifies_singleton_raw_type
assertions.description: Catches unchecked cast and raw type issue with the singleton pattern

assertions.name: structured_output
assertions.description: Review follows a clear structure with severity-based categorization
